desc: As a Utilize action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or have the &Reference[Prone] condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.
The Recover Ball Bearings activity grants another use of this item.
name: ball bearings
